title: Nexora Automation
build_command: docker run --rm -u 1000:1000 -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work --entrypoint sh louislam/uptime-kuma:2 -c 'npm ci && npm run build'

checks.production_build: passed: TypeScript and Vite; dist/index.html generated
checks.mobile: passed: Chromium 390x844; no document overflow; nav links hidden
checks.assets: passed: exact original video plays locally; Instrument Serif and Inter loaded
checks.interactions: passed: demo form, confirmation, navigation dialogs, preview video, Escape, focus restoration, mobile CTA

asset_issues: Optional original reference preview was absent; implementation follows PROMPT.md.
Chromium environment lacks an emoji glyph; bundled a 1.7 KB Noto Emoji subset and license for the sparkle.
Google Fonts CSS remains external as specified and requires runtime network access; verified successfully.
Some video requests are canceled with net::ERR_ABORTED on dialog teardown; source playback verified independently.
notes: Ready for review, not deployed. All work confined to this project.
Original CloudFront MP4 preserved locally; dashboard is React DOM and SVG, not a screenshot.
Native dialogs supply local preview interactions. Demo/contact submissions are local only, explicitly disclosed in the UI.
The play dialog uses the specified ambient video because no separate walkthrough asset was provided.
Build uses the required publication base /motionsites-results/nexora-automation/.
The viewport clips the dashboard intentionally, including its right side on phones.
